name: save-boot-1-load
description: #38 acceptance: boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-md1stin.json (md1stin, the progress value and triangle the game holds at after-battle) in slot 1. From the title, Circle every 30 frames (the title cursor starts on Continue, the slot cursor on slot 1 and the file cursor on save 1; no press reaches New Game) until the game is in field mode (g_GameState 1, confirmed #76; w_field), then the field loaded (segment field-loaded, #77's rule; load_done). Three checks: the field ID is the description's (md1stin, 116); the player stands on the description's walkmesh triangle 12 (the description's x is 0x7FFF, which makes the game place the player at that triangle's centroid: decomp FieldEntityInitPos), tri_ok; and the field is live: 60 still frames, then a walk up and right changes both PosX and PosY (signs since the mark, x_dir and y_dir). slot_mask: the FF7 saves the game listed on the card (1 = only save 1: the directory name is recognised). match: the same run again from the title snapshot ends in the same state.

slot_mask.description: g_SaveSlotMask: bit N set when the card holds BASCUS-94163FF7-S(N+1). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.main.us.txt, src/menu/savemenu.c GetSaveSlotMask. Hypothesis (#38).

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): the field ID.

loading.description: g_IsFieldLoading (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): 2 in a settled field.

player_model.description: g_PlayerModelId: the player's field model index (0 at md1stin, #77). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code).

tri0.description: g_FieldEntity[0].PosI (+0x72): the walkmesh triangle under the player. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) include/game.h FieldEntity.
